newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan LDP seeks speedier 'Big Bang' reforms--paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan LDP seeks speedier 'Big Bang' reforms--paper.

text.p: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) wants to speed up implementation of a five-year "Big Bang" financial deregulation plan, a newspaper reported on Thursday.
It is urging the scrapping of a securities transaction tax and liberalisation of stock brokerage commissions in 1998/1999, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun financial daily said.
The LDP has presented a draft proposal on the "Big Bang" financial deregulations to government ministries, it said.

In the proposal, it urges the government to bring forward implementation of reforms aimed at eliminating barriers between financial industry sectors to 1998/99 from the original target year of 2001/02, the paper said.
